objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of Cloud Computing
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world Cloud Computing tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in Cloud Computing
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with Cloud Computing industry best practices

prerequisites: Basic understanding of operating systems and IP networking concepts
Familiarity with command-line terminals and HTTP web requests

modules.title: Module 1: Cloud Architecture & Core Service Models
modules.summary: Master cloud deployment topologies, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS responsibility boundaries, Regions vs Availability Zones, and elastic compute selection.
modules.checkpoint: Classify cloud service workloads across IaaS, PaaS, Serverless, and Multi-AZ fault domains.

modules.title: Module 2: Cloud Networking (VPC) & Storage Architectures
modules.summary: Configure VPC IPv4 CIDR plans, public/private subnet routing, Security Groups vs NACLs, Object Storage, and managed cloud databases.
lessonTitles: Object Storage, Block Volumes & Managed Databases
modules.checkpoint: Calculate VPC subnet sizes and isolate database tiers safely from raw internet traffic.

modules.title: Module 3: Identity (IAM), Auto-Scaling & Cloud FinOps
modules.summary: Author least-privilege IAM roles, OIDC keyless CI/CD pipelines, multi-AZ Auto Scaling policies, and cloud cost governance.
lessonTitles: IAM Least-Privilege Policies & Keyless OIDC Identity
Auto-Scaling, Load Balancing & FinOps Cost Governance
modules.checkpoint: Refactor over-privileged policies cleanly and build fault-resilient auto-scaling rules.

practiceActivities: Audit and rewrite an overly permissive JSON IAM policy to strict least privilege
Design a Multi-AZ VPC CIDR subnet plan with public load balancers and private databases
Configure S3 lifecycle transition rules and CDN Origin Access Control headers
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: Cloud Architecture & Core Service Models Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Cloud Networking (VPC) & Storage Architectures Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: Identity (IAM), Auto-Scaling & Cloud FinOps Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: Multi-Tier High-Availability Cloud Architecture Blueprint & Least-Privilege IAM Repository
proficiencyCriteria: Explain the Shared Responsibility Model across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS boundaries
Calculate VPC CIDR blocks and configure public/private subnet routing safely
Author leak-proof IAM policies enforcing least privilege and TLS encryption
